thought.text:
**Penting!** Flag `force_string_serializer` **TIDAK menolong** untuk tool message. Dua-duanya 400.

Ini kabar buruk sekaligus menjelaskan semuanya. Saya cek apakah nomask bisa terima tool message dengan string.

action.command: cd /workspace/project && K="nmk_live_g1r1I3MMlZDJaclmlAFylupkQulRriMVhSaVx3xR"; echo "=== tool message content = STRING ==="; curl -s --max-time 60 -X POST "https://api.nomask.ai/v1/chat/completions" -H "Authorization: Bearer $K" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"deepseek_v4.1_flash_1017_uncensored","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"},{"role":"assistant","content":"","tool_calls":[{"id":"c1","type":"function","function":{"name":"bash","arguments":"{\"command\":\"ls\"}"}}]},{"role":"tool","tool_call_id":"c1","content":"file.txt"}],"max_tokens":30}' -w "\n[%{http_code}]\n" | head -c 280
